data.title: Tolnaftate
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Topical antifungals_

**Class:** Thiocarbamate antifungal

## Mechanism of action
- Inhibits squalene epoxidase (dermatophytes); inactive against Candida

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Tinea pedis, corporis, cruris, versicolor; prevention of tinea pedis (powder)

## Dose & formulations
- 1% cream/powder twice daily for 2–6 weeks

## Adverse effects
- Mild irritation

## Contraindications
- Nail and scalp infections (ineffective)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Safe.

## Viva points
- Inactive against Candida — wrong choice for intertrigo

_Sources: Khopkar ch.19; Wolverton 4e ch.42. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
